description: This Java source file defines the PayrollSystemAdapter class, which implements the PayrollSystemPort interface. The class is responsible for sending employee information to an external payroll system via JMS messaging. It uses Spring framework annotations for dependency injection and message handling, and configures JMS message properties such as correlation ID, delivery mode, message ID, priority, and expiration.

classes.name: PayrollSystemAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that adapts payroll employee info messages to an external payroll system via JMS, implementing the PayrollSystemPort interface.

methods.name: sendEmployeeInfo
methods.description: Sends employee information to an external payroll system by converting the DTO into a JMS message and setting specific message properties with a MessagePostProcessor.
